test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

You must__ lie in the bed you have made__.

options.text: Face the unpleasant consequences of your own acts
Sleep on the bed you made yourself

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"lie in the bed you have made"** means to accept the consequences of one's actions.

 
 
• **Example**: After cheating on the exam and getting caught, he had to lie in the bed he had made and face suspension.
 
 
 
• The correct option,** "Face the unpleasant consequences of your own acts," **means accepting responsibility for the negative outcomes of one's actions. 
 
 
• **Example**: She realized that by spreading rumors, she would eventually have to face the unpleasant consequences of her own acts.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is **Option 1**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**, "Sleep on the bed you made yourself," literally refers to sleeping on a bed that one has physically made. This does not capture the idiomatic meaning of facing one's consequences.
 
• **Option 3**, "Sleep in your own bed," literally means to sleep in one's own bed. It misses the metaphorical aspect of dealing with the results of one's actions.
 
• **Option 4**, "Be contended always," means to always be satisfied or happy with what one has. This option does not relate to the concept of facing consequences for one's actions.
